seoTitle: Change Font Size on Your TradingView Chart
metaDescription: Learn how to adjust text font size, line spacing, and color for annotations on your TradingView chart through the Canvas settings tab.
intro: Adjusting text size on TradingView can make annotations and notes easier to read, whether you're preparing charts for a presentation or just personalizing your own workspace. This guide covers finding the text formatting options and applying your changes.

steps.heading: Open the settings menu
steps.body: Click the gear icon in the upper right corner of your chart to open the settings panel.

steps.heading: Go to the Canvas tab
steps.body: Navigate to the Canvas section, where chart aesthetics including text formatting are managed.

steps.heading: Adjust font size
steps.body: Use the slider or input box to change the font size for annotations and labels on your chart.

steps.heading: Modify line spacing
steps.body: Adjust text line spacing to avoid cramped annotations or add more separation between lines.

steps.heading: Change font color
steps.body: Pick a font color that contrasts well with your chart background to improve visibility.

steps.heading: Save your changes
steps.body: Click OK to apply and save your font settings to the chart.

faq.question: Where do I change font size on TradingView?
faq.answer: Open chart settings via the gear icon, then go to the Canvas tab to adjust text formatting.

faq.question: Can I change font color as well as size?
faq.answer: Yes, the same Canvas settings section lets you adjust font color along with size and line spacing.

faq.question: Does this affect all annotations on my chart?
faq.answer: Yes, font settings apply to annotations and notes displayed on your chart.

faq.question: Will my font settings be saved automatically?
faq.answer: You need to click OK after making changes to save and apply your font settings.

faq.question: Why would I increase line spacing?
faq.answer: Increasing line spacing helps avoid cramped text and makes multi-line annotations easier to read.
